LESSON: LIGHT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.2: Light

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Light
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is light important in day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the sources of light in nature
2. describe ways of lighting a house in day- to- day life
3. explain the uses of light in day-to-day life
4. appreciate the applications of light in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Light

Teach
• Observe Light in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Light (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Light.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Light.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Light.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify the sources of light in nature
• describe ways of lighting a house in day- to- day life
• explain the uses of light in day-to-day life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Light.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Light: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is light important in day-to-day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the sources of light in nature
• describe ways of lighting a house in day- to- day life
• explain the uses of light in day-to-day life
• appreciate the applications of light in day-to-day life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
